'''Ultrapaint''' was a type of coating.

[[Hatch]]es of old [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] would be smeared with blue ultrapaint .<ref name="SotE">{{WEGCite|story=Bounty's Due|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

{{Substance-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ultrapaint appeared in "[[Bounty's Due]]," a short companion narrative included in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer's]] [[1996]] ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SotE" />
